operations.result: MATERIAL NEW: arXiv:2607.17858v1 (Rontani 2026, Organization of computation in reservoir computing: eigenspectral decomposition linking degree-wise IPC to state-space modes; substantial IPC may reside in low-energy modes vulnerable to experimental noise) admitted as ev-000000000009 (proposal ep_de84debb) with claim addressing prob:controllable-computational-possibility. NEGATIVE: TFLT unchanged (arXiv:2607.11186 remains latest); microring front hits (AIP SiN noise-robustness 2026-03, Dong 2026 Optik) predate this sweep or already admitted; CsPbBr3 persistent-memory front silent. Follow-up implication: kerr-capacity estimator should weight IPC by mode energy, since low-energy modes carrying IPC are noise-vulnerable (complements the ev-6 Richardson/Sobol bias follow-up).
